ask.body: Three slots, each for a different colour of glass.
ask.title: Which one are you holding?
camera.deniedBody: Everything except pointing at a bin still works. You can search by item, or say what shape and colour the bin is.
conn.waking: Waking the server. About ten seconds.
contribute.photoBody: It is shrunk on your phone first, stripped of location, and reviewed before anyone sees it.
coverage.draftBody: Transcribed from general practice and not yet checked against {source}'s own guidance. Treat them as a good guess.
desk.agreeBody: {n} independent sightings. Two are needed before it becomes an answer.
desk.coarseBody: A bin outside a single house is a fact about that house. Locations are held to about five metres and household bins drop off the map as they age.
desk.emptyBody: This town has no rules pack. Somebody has to be first, and the first entry is a form with six shapes and ten colours on it.
desk.keyboardBody: J and K move, Enter opens, P publishes, S splits a wrongly merged cluster. Nothing here needs a mouse.
desk.pinsShow: pins show when each was last confirmed
desk.publishBody: Agreement is enough to publish a rule. It is never enough to enter the training set – that needs a person to check it.
disambiguation.glass_color.note: Three slots, each for a different colour of glass.
firstRun.camBody: You can also search the rules by hand, without a camera, at any time.
firstRun.camTitle: The camera is only on while you are looking
firstRun.coverage: We know {n} bins in {place}. Elsewhere we are still learning, and we will say so.
firstRun.pitch: Point your phone at a bin. We tell you what goes in it.
firstRun.privacyBody: No account, no location history, no pictures kept.
firstRun.privacyTitle: Nothing leaves your phone unless you send it
frame.singleNote: 92% of the archive is a single bin.
frame.sixNote: No photograph of a container bank exists in the archive. This layout is a probe.
frame.threeNote: Three touching containers. A real frame from the archive.
hedge.body: A grey lid usually means this here, but this street has not been confirmed. Check the sticker on the lid if there is one.
hedge.title: Not certain
item.aerosol_cans_full: Aerosol cans that are not empty
item.bottles_without_label: Bottles with the label left on
item.paint_tins_full: Paint tins that are not empty
note.batteries: Take these to a collection box in a shop.
note.bioplastic_bags: Not accepted here, despite the label.
note.ceramics: Melts at a different temperature. It ruins the batch.
note.wet_textiles: Wet textiles spoil the whole container.
pending.body: You are the only person who sees this. Nobody else is told anything about this bin until one more person reports the same thing.
pending.title: Yours, waiting for a second pair of eyes
provenance.notChecked: not yet checked against the operator
region.de_by_deggendorf.operator_note: Waste for the Deggendorf district is handled by ZAW Donau-Wald.
region.de_by_deggendorf.packaging_note: Collected as a yellow sack in some streets and a yellow-lidded bin in others.
rules.noMatchBody: A few dozen everyday items are covered here. If yours is missing we would like to know.
rules.noPackBody: These are the general rules for each kind of waste. Which container they belong to in {place} is the part nobody has written down yet.
rules.title: Rules
scan.nothingBody: Step back a little so a whole bin fits, or search the rules instead.
scan.offlineBody: Recognising a bin needs a connection. Reading the rules does not.
scan.offlineTitle: The rules are on your phone
scan.probeTitle: Six containers has never been photographed
scan.searching: Looking at what is in frame.
scan.timeoutBody: Nothing held still long enough to be sure. Take one picture instead, or step back so a whole bin fits.
sent.body: One other person needs to see the same bin before it becomes an answer for everybody. Until then it is yours alone, marked pending.
sent.title: Sent. Not published yet.
sent.whyBody: Telling somebody the wrong thing goes in the wrong bin is the worst thing this app could do. Two independent sightings is the cheapest guard against it.
settings.aboutBody: Free to use and free to run. The waste rules come from each local authority, and every screen that uses them says which one and when it was checked.
settings.cachedBody: It opens and the rules work with no connection at all.
settings.cachedTitle: This app is on your phone
settings.cameraBlocked: This site is blocked from using the camera. Your browser's site settings can undo that; nothing here can.
settings.installBody: On your home screen it opens full screen and stays ready offline.
settings.installManual: Your browser installs web apps from its own menu – look for add to home screen, or install.
settings.localeGap: Some strings are still in English. Advice about what goes where is never machine-translated, so you see the English rather than a guess.
settings.modeBody: Sun is not a bright theme. It drops the warm tint and thickens every rule, for reading a screen outdoors at noon.
settings.notCachedBody: Come back once with a connection and the app keeps itself for the times you have none.
settings.privacyFrames: Pictures are looked at and thrown away. One is kept only when you have chosen to contribute it.
settings.privacyPlace: Where you are travels as an area about a kilometre across – enough to pick the right town, not enough to find a house.
settings.title: Settings
settings.transportBody.mock: What the camera screen shows comes from stored examples, not from anything looking at your camera. Everything else here is real.
settings.transportBody.rest: Each picture is sent on its own. There is no live view on this device.
settings.transportBody.socket: Pictures go over one open connection, and the next is only sent once the last has been answered.
settings.updateBody: It will be used the next time you open the app, or now if you prefer. Nothing you have sent is lost either way.
stale.body: Bins move. If this one is where we say it is, one tap keeps the next person right.
stale.title: Last confirmed a while ago
stream.batteries.note: Never in a household bin. Fire risk, not a sorting error.
stream.bio.note: Food and plant matter only. No bags, even the compostable ones, unless the operator says so.
stream.bulky.note: Too large for a container. Usually collected by appointment.
stream.cigarette.note: Put out first. A warm end can set a whole bin alight.
stream.deposit_return.note: Take these back to a shop for the deposit rather than binning them.
stream.dog_waste.note: Bagged, in a dog-waste bin or the residual bin.
stream.ewaste.note: Anything with a plug, a battery or a circuit board.
stream.garden.note: Plant matter from a garden. Soil and stones are not garden waste.
stream.glass_brown.note: Sorted by the colour of the glass, not the colour of the label.
stream.glass_clear.note: Sorted by the colour of the glass, not the colour of the label.
stream.glass_green.note: Blue and red glass usually go here too.
stream.glass_mixed.note: One container for every colour. Where slots are colour-coded, the app asks which one.
stream.hazardous.note: Bring these to a collection point in person. Do not post them.
stream.medicines.note: Rules differ sharply by country. Check before assuming.
stream.metal.note: Metal that is not packaging and not electrical.
stream.packaging.note: Packaging, not the material. A plastic toy is not packaging.
stream.paper.note: Flatten boxes. Anything greasy or plastic-lined belongs elsewhere.
stream.residual.note: Whatever is left when everything with its own container has been taken out.
stream.street_litter.note: For litter carried in hand. Not for household waste.
stream.textiles.note: Clean and dry only. One wet bag spoils the container.
stream.unknown.note: We have not been told what this container is for here.
unknown.normal: This is normal in a town we have just started on. Three taps and it becomes an answer for the next person.
unknown.regionBody: No rules have been written for this town. Every bin here comes back unknown until somebody starts it, and starting it is a few taps.
unknown.seeBody: What we cannot say is what that means in {place}. Nobody has told us yet.
unknown.street: See what else is on this street
unknown.title: We don't know this bin yet
